findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: The class now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler but its body is just `pass`. The base class declares `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values` and the newly added `build_occurrence_and_event_data` as abstract. None of these are implemented, so `MetricAlertDetectorHandler(detector)` raises TypeError. `Detector.detector_handler` calls `group_type.detector_handler(self)`, so any detector of type `metric_alert_fire` will now crash in `process_detectors`. Before this change the handler returned [] and was instantiable.

findings.title: evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: The docstring of StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate says it 'returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`', but the method now returns a dict keyed by group key. The abstract signature in DetectorHandler was updated, so this docstring is now wrong and will mislead implementers.
